summary: A tool an LLM can call: reads run directly, side effects only through the policy executor, a tool result never authorizes a write, external results wrapped untrusted, loop caps unchanged, contract doc in the same PR.

required_inputs.name: tool
required_inputs.description: Name, registry location and whether it reads or has side effects

required_inputs.name: executor
required_inputs.description: For a side effect: the policy executor and action kind it goes through

required_inputs.name: blast_radius
required_inputs.description: What the tool can reach: one tenant, one user, or global

required_inputs.name: contract_doc
required_inputs.description: The tool contract doc the consumer reads

checklist.rule: A read runs directly; a side effect goes only through the policy executor for its action kind, one executor per kind
checklist.because: LINDA Ask LINDA: one executor per action kind, the policy decides, not the model; linda_outcomes never imports the router

checklist.rule: A tool result never authorizes a write; authorization comes from the policy and the caller's scope
checklist.because: A model that reads 'approved: true' from a tool result and writes on it is the confused-deputy path the LINDA design forbids

checklist.rule: External or user-supplied results are wrapped as untrusted data and namespaced so they cannot pose as instructions
checklist.because: Quadratus Fable safety classifiers and LINDA transcripts both carry text that reads like instructions

checklist.rule: Tool-call loop caps, fetch caps and consult caps stay as they are; a tool that needs more stops and asks
checklist.because: Quadratus max_fetches and max_consults exist because open-ended loops burned windows; LINDA loop caps are a safety property

checklist.rule: The static system block stays byte-stable; new tool descriptions go in the tool schema, not the prompt
checklist.because: LINDA prompt caching keys on the static block; a changed byte invalidates every cache

checklist.rule: The tool applies the same scope predicate as the equivalent endpoint; tenant and user come from the session, never from tool arguments
checklist.because: Flex MCP routes are API routes under another name; r3cruit3r agents_router scopes by user

checklist.rule: The tool contract doc changes in the same PR
checklist.because: LINDA test_integration_contract_docs; the doc is what the consumer and the operator read

checklist.rule: The tool schema is strict; unknown fields are rejected and required fields are enforced before the handler runs
checklist.because: Models invent arguments; a lenient schema turns an invented field into a silent default

checklist.rule: The done output states the blast radius: what the tool can read or change and for whom
checklist.because: The three Flex MCP servers and the War Room MCP server each reach production data; a reviewer needs the radius in one line

done_output: tool name, registry entry and read or side-effect classification
executor and action kind for a side effect
static block hash before and after
stop_conditions: a side effect has no executor for its action kind
the task asks to raise a loop cap
the task asks the tool to write on the strength of a tool result

adapter_fields.name: policy_executor
adapter_fields.description: The executor side effects go through, per action kind

adapter_fields.name: untrusted_wrapper
adapter_fields.description: How external results are wrapped and namespaced

adapter_fields.name: loop_caps
adapter_fields.description: Where the caps live and their current values

adapter_fields.name: static_block_path
adapter_fields.description: The cached system block, for the hash gate
